title: Shopify and Zoho CRM Integration
seoTitle: Shopify Zoho CRM Integration: Customers and Orders
seoDescription: Sync Shopify customers and orders into Zoho CRM for segmentation, follow-ups and repeat-purchase campaigns. What to sync and how to avoid duplicates.
summary: A Shopify–Zoho CRM integration creates or updates a contact in Zoho for every Shopify customer and records their orders, so sales and marketing teams can segment buyers, follow up on high-value orders and run repeat-purchase campaigns from one place.

dataPoints.label: What syncs
dataPoints.value: Customers, orders, order value, products bought, abandoned carts (optional)

dataPoints.label: Key rule
dataPoints.value: Match customers by email or phone to prevent duplicates

dataPoints.label: Typical uses
dataPoints.value: B2B or high-value D2C follow-up, repeat-purchase reminders, VIP segments

dataPoints.label: Typical effort
dataPoints.value: 2–4 weeks for a custom sync; marketplace connectors for simpler needs

body:
## Duplicates are the main risk

Customers check out with different emails or phone formats. Normalise phone numbers to one format and decide which field is the unique key before syncing.

## Pair with WhatsApp

CRM segments become useful when followed by action. See [Zoho CRM and WhatsApp](/integrations/zoho-crm-whatsapp) and [Shopify and WhatsApp](/integrations/shopify-whatsapp).

Tool features and APIs change; confirm current capabilities before scoping.

faqs.q: Should every Shopify customer go into the CRM?
faqs.a: Not always. Many brands sync only customers above an order value or with repeat purchases.

faqs.q: Can Zoho show live order status?
faqs.a: Yes, if order updates are synced; otherwise link to the Shopify order.
